title: Hamid Barkzi On Facing Prince Narula in The 50: 'He Plays to Win, Pressure Is High' | Television News - News18
text: Roadies Revolution and Splitsvilla 14 winner Hamid Barkzi is all set to embrace a fresh challenge as he joins the upcoming reality show The 50. The reality show introduces a unique format featuring 50 contestants and high-stakes gameplay, where viewers can bet on the winner for a chance to win Rs 50 lakh. And it is already creating a massive buzz. Adding to the excitement, one of reality TV’s most celebrated faces, Prince Narula , is also entering the competition. Prince, who has won MTV Roadies 12, MTV Splitsvilla 8, Bigg Boss 9, and Nach Baliye 9, was previously Hamid’s mentor during Roadies. Now, with mentor and mentee set to face each other on this intense battlefield, Hamid has opened up about how it feels to reunite with Prince under such high-pressure circumstances. Hamid Barkzi on his mentor Prince Narula being a part of The 50 In an interview with Hindustan Times, when asked about competing against his former mentor Prince Narula, Hamid said, “If he’s there, it’s a moment of pride for me. He was my leader and mentor in Roadies, and now we’ll be contestants together. He is extremely passionate about games, just like me. When he plays, he plays to win. So the pressure will be 100 per cent, but at the end of the day, it will be an individual game." How The 50 is different from Roadies, Splitsvilla and Bigg Boss Explaining how The 50 stands apart from the reality shows he has previously been part of, including Roadies, Splitsvilla and Bigg Boss, Hamid said, “When I understood the concept, I realised that the tasks here will be very different than that in Roadies and Splitsvilla." “The biggest challenge is that you’re playing with 50 people. We’ll have to see whether it’s better to play individually or as part of an alliance," he added. Comparing it to the Bigg Boss, Hamid noted, “It has 50 people and a much bigger space than Bigg Boss. But the kalesh will be pro-max because there are 50 people and everyone will have their own opinions." The 50: Contestants Alongside Hamid and Prince Narula, The 50 also stars Yuvika Choudhary, Manisha Rani, Nikki Tamboli, Rajat Dalal, Lovekesh Kataria, Karan Patel, Divya Agarwal, Faisal Mallik, Nehal Chudasama, Manisha Rani, Bebika Dhurve, Shiv Thakare and Arbaz Patel, among others. The show will premiere on February 1 on Colors TV and JioHotstar.
